nodes.label: Disclaimer of Warranty and Limitation of Liability (Sections 7-8)
nodes.rationale: Work is provided AS IS with no warranties and no contributor liability, which is what makes an unpaid tax-document parser distributable at all.
nodes.norm_label: disclaimer of warranty and limitation of liability (sections 7-8)

nodes.label: Grant of Patent License (Section 3)
nodes.rationale: Patent grant terminates if the licensee files patent litigation over the Work, a defensive-termination trade-off in exchange for the irrevocable royalty-free grant.

nodes.label: Redistribution Conditions (Section 4)
nodes.rationale: Redistribution requires shipping the license, marking modified files, retaining attribution notices, and propagating any NOTICE file.

nodes.label: Non-standard appendix note about Eclipse Public License

nodes.label: ExpCore App Icon (SVG)
nodes.rationale: 256x256 rounded-square app icon: purple gradient tile with a white document glyph, signalling a file/document-processing desktop tool; vector source likely used to generate icon.ico

nodes.label: Penamaan Otomatis Bupot
nodes.rationale: If the name in the chosen source (C.3 or A.2) is empty or unreadable the PDF is skipped rather than falling back to the other source; CSV log still records NAMA_PENERIMA, NAMA_PEMOTONG and sumber_nama for audit.

nodes.label: Rekening Koran (BCA e-Statement Recap)
nodes.rationale: Summary written in a separate panel (not under the table nor merged into descriptions) so SUM, filter and sort on DEBIT/CREDIT only count transactions.

nodes.label: Format-mismatch PDFs Skipped & Logged
nodes.rationale: BPPU (2026) and BPBS (2024) forms are read by separate modules that do not substitute for each other; choosing the wrong menu does not corrupt data.

nodes.label: Rekening Koran Automatic Check (Hasil Cek / PERLU CEK)
nodes.norm_label: rekening koran automatic check (hasil cek / perlu cek)

nodes.label: Position-based Column Detection (BCA e-Statement)
nodes.rationale: Columns recognized by page position so branch codes and numbers inside descriptions are not mistaken for amounts; split words are joined with a space exactly as in the PDF because a split word cannot be told apart from separate columns.

nodes.label: Sifat Read From H.4/H.5 Checkbox
nodes.rationale: If not exactly one box is checked the column holds '-' instead of guessing.

nodes.label: Verification Results 9 Oct 2026 (name source & Rekening Koran)
nodes.rationale: 6 real BCA e-Statements all SESUAI (5,121 table words each in exactly one column); E2E dev 30/30 at 100/125/150%, packaged 34 pass + 1 skipped; Nuitka and Python engines produce identical Excel. Found and fixed header overflow, indicator spring overflow, centered-nav shift, and a flaky wheel test.
nodes.norm_label: verification results 9 oct 2026 (name source & rekening koran)

nodes.label: Text-based Status Labels & Contrast
nodes.rationale: Status is always text (MENUNGGU FOLDER ... PERLU DIPERIKSA) so color is never the only differentiator; contrast ink-soft 8:1, ink-muted 4.9:1, white on brand-600 4.7:1.

nodes.label: Header Pill Navigation with Sliding Indicator
nodes.rationale: Nav is left-aligned next to the logo (not centered) so the active tool name lengthens the Alat button to the right without shifting Beranda. Pill clips the sliding indicator and the spring starts at velocity 0: fixes a bug where rapid tool switching let ResizeObserver jump the indicator and the next spring inherited that velocity (indicator reached 2,680 px).
nodes.norm_label: header pill navigation with sliding indicator

nodes.label: Reduced Motion Support (prefers-reduced-motion)
nodes.rationale: All Motion and CSS animations disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; initial reveal state set in CSS to avoid a flash before scripts run.

nodes.label: Tools Menu (disclosure pattern, grouped)
nodes.rationale: Disclosure pattern (aria-expanded button + button list, not role=menu), grouped Ekstraksi ke Excel / Kelola PDF. Replaced six header items after the header overflowed 86 px at 960 px width; grouping restores full titles and keeps header labels always visible from 960-1400 px.

nodes.label: Query: Why E2E Test Suite bridges E2E app tests, NSIS verification, update tests and process architecture
nodes.rationale: E2E tests drive the app as a separate process (Playwright _electron, DOM selectors, app.evaluate) without importing app code, so AST sees no edge; only DESIGN.md Kode: lines link tests/app.test.js and tests/update.test.js into the graph. Consequence: graph did not know which test verifies which feature (it() blocks are not nodes).
nodes.norm_label: query: why e2e test suite bridges e2e app tests, nsis verification, update tests and process architecture

nodes.label: Electron E2E Test Suite (npm test)
nodes.rationale: Runs on dev build and, with EXPCORE_APP, on the packaged app plus update.test.js against a local server; EXPCORE_SCALE=1.25/1.5 for display scaling; failures save screenshot and UI state to %TEMP%\expcore-e2e-artefak.

nodes.rationale: Test resilience: minimized/moved test windows restored before each test and waits use interval polling instead of animation frames.

nodes.label: Log Edge Mouse-Wheel Forwarding
nodes.rationale: At the log edge the wheel is forwarded to the page explicitly because native scroll chaining is inconsistent at fractional DPI (125%/150%).

nodes.label: Name Source Selection (C.3 Pemotong / A.2 Wajib Pajak)
nodes.rationale: Changing the source cancels the preview; main process only accepts apply for the same folder and name source as the last preview, so a rename can never use an unpreviewed source.

nodes.norm_label: five-tool workspace (ekstraksi ke excel / kelola pdf)

nodes.label: ExpCore Desktop Workspace (DESIGN.md)
nodes.rationale: Light, soft SaaS visual language (bluish-white canvas, purple accent, lavender panels, rounded white cards, Inter); Motion used sparingly so the UI feels alive without disturbing document work. Every concept carries a Kode: reference to the implementing function.

nodes.label: Job Locking (main process is source of truth)
nodes.rationale: Folder and processing controls lock during a job while navigation stays free; the Electron main process owns job state to prevent stacked jobs.
nodes.norm_label: job locking (main process is source of truth)

nodes.label: Native Confirmation Dialogs (Batal as default)
nodes.rationale: Replacing a recap or applying names needs native confirmation with action-named buttons and Batal default; closing or installing an update while a job runs is held until results and logs are written.

nodes.label: Rename Requires Completed Preview
nodes.rationale: Apply button only enabled after a finished preview, and main process also rejects apply for a folder without preview (defense in depth).

nodes.label: Visual Tokens (@theme in styles.css)
nodes.rationale: All tokens defined once in the @theme block and consumed as Tailwind classes, so color/radius/shadow have a single source.

nodes.label: Automatic Update (electron-updater, GitHub Releases, SHA-512 latest.yml)
nodes.rationale: No download or install without user consent; install held while a PDF job runs; only public release metadata over HTTPS, no user data or GitHub token.
nodes.norm_label: automatic update (electron-updater, github releases, sha-512 latest.yml)

nodes.label: package.json version as Single Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: package.json version as single source of truth

nodes.label: Release Publishing Steps (tag v+version, upload latest.yml)
nodes.norm_label: release publishing steps (tag v+version, upload latest.yml)

nodes.label: Renderer Build (Tailwind CLI + esbuild)
nodes.rationale: src/ is not packaged; npm start, npm test and build_release.py rebuild the renderer automatically so the app never ships stale CSS/JS.

nodes.label: Single Instance (second launch opens no new window)
nodes.norm_label: single instance (second launch opens no new window)

nodes.label: Three-part Build Pipeline (renderer, Nuitka engine, electron-builder)
nodes.rationale: Since 3.0 Nuitka compiles only the Python engine; the window is Electron and Inno Setup is replaced by electron-builder NSIS, which also emits latest.yml for auto-update.
nodes.norm_label: three-part build pipeline (renderer, nuitka engine, electron-builder)

nodes.label: Strict CSP & Navigation/Permission Lockdown
nodes.rationale: Renderer loads only local files under strict CSP (no inline script/style, no eval); navigation, new windows, webviews and device permissions denied; no default menu or DevTools in installed app.

nodes.label: Two Build Rules (explicit venv, forward slashes)
nodes.norm_label: two build rules (explicit venv, forward slashes)

nodes.label: Explicit .venv python.exe Rule
nodes.rationale: Bare python follows PATH and may resolve to another interpreter even with a venv 'activated'.

nodes.label: Forward-slash Path Rule
nodes.rationale: Forward slashes work in PowerShell and Git Bash; backslash is an escape char in Git Bash and mangles .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe.

nodes.label: Nuitka Bundles From the Running Interpreter
nodes.rationale: Missing modules do not fail a Nuitka build, only warn and yield a broken exe; build_release.py therefore uses the explicit venv path and smoke-runs the built engine on synthetic PDFs.
nodes.norm_label: nuitka bundles from the running interpreter

nodes.label: Manual 2.x Uninstall Requirement
nodes.rationale: 3.x installer does not remove 2.x; without manual uninstall there are two entries and removing the old one later can break 3.x in the same folder.

nodes.label: App Icon (icon.svg source, icon.ico 15 sizes)
nodes.rationale: Same tile as header logo; each of 15 ICO sizes drawn natively, glyph enlarged to 66% at <=32 px so it stays legible in title bar and taskbar.
